role: Everything src/no-hover-behavior.test.ts lets through, and why. A move handler is a drag only while a button is held; nothing here may light, show or open anything because the pointer rests. An entry that matches nothing fails the test (remove the line).

allowed.reason: bar-range selection by dragging: onMove returns at once unless a press started in a bar (pressedIn), so a resting pointer does nothing
the pane divider drag: the move listener is added on pointerdown and removed on pointerup, so it only runs while the button is held
positions Obsidian's own status-bar tooltip, which Obsidian draws from the item's aria-label (its core feature, not a tooltip this plugin draws)
clears a native title so two tooltips cannot stack; it never sets one
clears a native title (Obsidian draws the status-bar tooltip itself); it never sets one
an Obsidian ButtonComponent's accessible name: Obsidian's own tooltip API, not a hover handler of this plugin (said in the FEEDBACK as the one place Obsidian's core hover remains)
not a tooltip: the workspace leaf's tab title, set so the tab reads as the note
dragging the bridge: move() returns at once unless the pointer is held down (the dragging flag is set on pointerdown, cleared on pointerup), so a resting pointer does nothing
